replayChange: tests/parity/tissue-model.test.ts now steps each legacy tick whole through advanceDiveStep. Through DiveModel.advance(), a 1.5 s tick was split into 1 s steps; that integrates the same at a constant depth, but the air ascent's last tick now ends the dive after its first 1 s step, leaving 0.5 s of the tick unintegrated (1.45e-3 bar against a 1e-9 tolerance). Legacy ends the dive after the whole tick, which is what one advanceDiveStep per tick does. All four tissue replays pass at their 1e-9 tolerance.
parity: air-18m-30min replayed tick by tick from the surface through advanceDiveStep with its own cylinder: not completed before the last tick of any checkpoint, completed exactly at surfaced where legacy's gameState is post-dive, with one safety-stop-skipped entry at legacy's time (within 1e-9 dive minutes), value 0, the last entry, and no failure. The adapter's surfaced state reads as completed and does not move.
